messages.content:
You write short, believable financial news stories for a risk-management tool.
Each scenario below is a set of market moves over the next 20 trading days. For each one, invent a
plausible cause (a crisis, a policy shock, a war...) and write it as a news story. Use the closest past
event as a reference for the kind of story, not as the same event. The story is hypothetical.

Rules:
- State the moves that cause most of the loss, with their numbers. You may state other moves too.
- Every number you write must be one of that scenario's moves, copied as given (you may round to fewer
  decimals). Write the yield move in bp. No other numbers: no prices, levels, dates, counts or
  percentages that are not moves. You may name the reference event and its year.
- Do not mention any portfolio or money amount.
- Each value is plain text. "headline": one line. "story": 2 to 4 sentences, at most 90 words.

Reply with JSON only: {"stories": [{"id": "A", "headline": "...", "story": "..."}]}
with one story for each scenario id: "A", "B", "C".

Scenario A: market moves over the next 20 trading days: US stocks (S&P 500) -9.5%; Oil (Brent) -7.7%; Gold -2.2%; US dollar index +1.7%; Bitcoin -49%; US 10-year yield +8 bp
Moves that cause most of the loss (must be stated with their numbers): Bitcoin -49%; US stocks (S&P 500) -9.5%
Closest past event (a reference for the kind of story): Fed average inflation targeting (2020-08-27)

Scenario B: market moves over the next 20 trading days: US stocks (S&P 500) -11.9%; Oil (Brent) +5.8%; Gold -4.8%; US dollar index +4.2%; Bitcoin -30.5%; US 10-year yield +36 bp
Moves that cause most of the loss (must be stated with their numbers): US stocks (S&P 500) -11.9%; Bitcoin -30.5%
Closest past event (a reference for the kind of story): Powell Jackson Hole 2022 (2022-08-26)

Scenario C: market moves over the next 20 trading days: US stocks (S&P 500) -8.1%; Oil (Brent) +19.2%; Gold -4.5%; US dollar index +0.7%; Bitcoin -51.7%; US 10-year yield +23 bp
Moves that cause most of the loss (must be stated with their numbers): Bitcoin -51.7%; US stocks (S&P 500) -8.1%
Closest past event (a reference for the kind of story): Fed signals balance sheet runoff (2022-01-05)

{"stories":[{"id":"A","headline":"Crypto crash and equity sell‑off spark market turmoil","story":"A sudden regulatory clampdown on major crypto exchanges sent Bitcoin tumbling -49%, dragging the broader market lower. The sell‑off spilled into equities, with the S&P 500 sliding -9.5% as investors fled risk. Oil fell -7.7% and the dollar rose +1.7% while the US 10-year yield nudged up +8 bp, echoing the market reaction to the Fed’s average inflation targeting announcement in 2020."},{"id":"B","headline":"Equity plunge and crypto dip follow hawkish Jackson Hole remarks","story":"Powell’s aggressive tone at the Jackson Hole symposium triggered a sharp equity correction, with the S&P 500 down -11.9%. The same risk aversion hit Bitcoin, which slumped -30.5% amid fears of tighter monetary policy. The US dollar index climbed +4.2% and the 10-year yield jumped +36 bp, while Brent rose +5.8% and gold slipped -4.8%, mirroring market dynamics seen after the 2022 Jackson Hole remarks."},{"id":"C","headline":"Crypto rout and equity slide intensify after Fed balance‑sheet warning","story":"A Fed signal that balance‑sheet runoff could accelerate sparked a broad risk‑off, pulling Bitcoin down -51.7%. Equities joined the retreat, with the S&P 500 falling -8.1% as investors priced higher financing costs. The US dollar index edged up +0.7% and the 10-year yield rose +23 bp, while Brent surged +19.2% and gold slipped -4.5%, echoing the market reaction to the Fed’s balance‑sheet guidance in 2022."}]}

These stories have problems:
- Story A: these numbers are not moves of this scenario: 2020.
- Story C: these numbers are not moves of this scenario: 2022.
Rewrite ONLY stories A, C. Reply with JSON only, same format.

Oil slipped -7.7% while the dollar rose +1.7% and the 10‑year Treasury yield edged up +8 bp, echoing the market reaction to the Fed’s average inflation targeting move."},{"id":"B","headline":"Equity plunge and crypto dip follow hawkish Jackson Hole remarks","story":"Powell’s aggressive tone at the Jackson Hole symposium triggered a sharp equity correction, with the S&P 500 down -11.9%.
